posts.title: Google Ads budget mistakes to avoid
posts.caption_ig:
Spending on Google Ads but the phone isn't ringing? Check these 5 first:

1. No conversion tracking — Google optimises for clicks instead of leads.
2. No negative keywords — you pay for “free”, “jobs” and “DIY” searches.
3. Broad match on a small budget — it needs data you don't have yet.
4. Every ad goes to the homepage — send each search to the page that answers it.
5. Judging by impressions — cost per lead is the only number that pays.

Save this before your next budget review.

Want a second pair of eyes on your account? DM us “ADS”.

#googleads #ppc #digitalmarketing #marketingtips #dubaibusiness
